content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early periods of the 30-day forecast, especially after sharp declines or dips.
- Overestimates prices following recent spikes or high historical values, showing overshoot bias.
- Tends to lag behind true price movements, particularly in the first 5–10 days of the forecast horizon.
- Mean reversion is overemphasized — model often predicts a return to prior averages too quickly, missing sustained trends.
- Forecasts show higher variance than actual price movements, especially in the middle of the horizon.
- Underestimates upward momentum in the final 5–10 days of the forecast, particularly when true prices rise sharply.
- Overconfident in short-term reversals — model frequently predicts sharp drops after minor spikes, which rarely materialize.
- Sensitive to recent low values — model reacts too strongly to recent lows, causing premature overcorrection.
